verdicts.title: Factorizations for variable exponent Muckenhoupt weights
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given two variable exponent Muckenhoupt weights $w\in A_{p(\cdot)}$ and $w_1\in A_{p_1(\cdot)}$, we prove that for all small enough $θ>0,$ there holds that $w_0\in A_{p_0(\cdot)},$ where the weight is determined by $w = w_0^{1-θ}w_1^θ$ and exponent of the weight class by $1/p(\cdot) = (1-θ)/p_0(\cdot) + θ/p_1(\cdot).$ The proof is based on a recent reverse Hölder's inequality for variable exponent Muckenhoupt weights by Cruz-Uribe and Penrod. verdicts.title: The adjoint representation of a Lie algebra and the support of Kostant's weight multiplicity formula
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Even though weight multiplicity formulas, such as Kostant's formula, exist their computational use is extremely cumbersome.
